frontier_selector.why: The presence of a submucosal mass with a low-echo lesion and regular, clear margins, along with a vascular signal, specifically supports Gastrointestinal Stromal Tumor (GIST).

support_spans: a 103 × 46.6 mm submucosal mass on the lesser curvature of the stomach
a low-echo lesion with regular, clear margins confined to the submucosal layer
a vascular signal extending from the periphery into the center of the lesion

contradict_spans: a low-echo lesion with regular, clear margins confined to the submucosal layer
